note: E12: the selector refusals, before any pair starts. Every one is 400 with code and, where a choice exists, the candidate pairs. A request the release-9 server already refused keeps that refusal's error text byte for byte (the code is an added member), apart from the texts that named a configured path, which train 8 words without one (SPEC-multigraph-envelope.md section 6). The names cap (max_graphs_without_selection) keeps its existing 400. An empty graphs on a multi-graph /search (train 4) was answered 200 with the body null before; it selects no pair and is refused with pair_not_found, before any cached answer. T8-M6 (train 8, pair identity; SPEC-multigraph-envelope.md section 1.2): each pair is named by graph and pair_id, master's n1 id of the name and the two paths as the graph list spells them (the paths this sample stated before), and no configured path is stated; the texts that named configured paths name the pair by its name and pair_id (section 6).
